entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return these useless cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Michael Vance, and the order is VF88-1259. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. These shoes are a disaster.

Thank you, Michael. I have your account pulled up. I see the order for the Pro-Level cycling shoes, delivered about 57 days ago. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

A fault? They're instruments of torture! I've tried everything, but they've given me horrible blisters on every single ride. And the cleats... I can't get them to sit right no matter what I do. I want a full refund, and I want it now. This is ridiculous for what I paid.

I understand your frustration completely. Getting blisters is the last thing you want when you're trying to enjoy a ride. I can see you're one of our long-time VIP members, and we certainly don't want you to have that kind of experience with our gear.

You're damn right I'm a VIP. And if I don't get this sorted out, I'll be taking my business elsewhere and making sure everyone on every cycling forum knows about it. Are you going to give me my refund or do I need to speak to your manager?

That won't be necessary, Michael. I can handle this for you right now. I've just reviewed our policy. Since you're well within the 90-day return window for the cycling shoes, I can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh. Well... okay then. So what happens now?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just pack the shoes and cleats back in the box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method.
Fine. That's what I expected in the first place.

Absolutely. And again, I do apologize for the trouble you've had with the blisters and the fit. As a thank you for your loyalty and patience today, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase with us. I hope we can help you find a pair of shoes that are a much better fit.
A credit? Huh. Okay. That's... that's good. Thank you, David. I appreciate you sorting this out quickly.
You're very welcome, Michael. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just the return. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
